definitions.full: H7279. ragan רָגַן verb murmur, whisper (Late Hebrew id. ; ᵑ7 Ithpe`el bickbite, slander ); — 1 murmur (rebelliously): — Qal Participle plural רוֺגְנִים Isa 29:24 murmurers ; Niph`al Imperfect 3masculine plural וַיֵּרָֽגְנוּ Psa 106:25 and they murmured in their tents, so 2 masculine plural וַתֵּרָֽגְנוּ Deut 1:27 . 2 whisper (maliciously), backlite, slander: , Niph`al Participle נִרְגָּן backbiter Prov 16:28 ; 18:8 ; 26:20 , 22 .
